decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the plans numbered 1760.C.02, 1760.C.30A, 1760.C.31, 1760.C.03, 1760.C.25A, 1760.C.26A, 1760.C.28, 1760.C.39A, 1760.C.40A, 1760.C.19B, 1760.C.20B, 1760.C.21B, 1760.C.23B, 1760.C.38B and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No demolition of construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am and 6pm on Mondays to Saturday and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior permission of the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
description: Erection of ground floor side extensions, alterations to external openings and fitting of solar panel to roof.
